title: Getting started with ShuttleboxR
text: ShuttleboxR provides single workflow moving raw ShuttleSoft file calculated thermal behavioural metrics. can: import ShuttleSoft .txt files comma-separated .csv exports; label acclimation trial periods; retain core_T values already generated ShuttleSoft; calculate thermal preference, avoidance temperatures, thermal breadth, shuttling, chamber occupancy, movement, tracking quality; create plots individual trials; summarise trials project.
code: library(ShuttleboxR) #> Warning in rgl.init(initValue, onlyNULL): RGL: unable to open X11 display #> Warning: 'rgl.init' failed, will use the null device. #> See '?rgl.useNULL' for ways to avoid this warning.

title: Getting started with ShuttleboxR
text: simplest way import file : file.choose() opens ordinary file-selection window. returned data prepared automatically, calculation plotting functions can used immediately. vignette uses shortened ShuttleSoft recording included package: Check size first column names: can also run:
code: fish <- read_shuttlesoft(file.choose()) example_file <- system.file(   "extdata",   "Fish_8_13_3_example.csv",   package = "ShuttleboxR" )  fish <- read_shuttlesoft(example_file) dim(fish) #> [1] 6000   41 head(names(fish), 12) #>  [1] "time"         "zone"         "core_T"       "Tpref_loligo" "INCR_T"       #>  [6] "DECR_T"       "x_pos"        "y_pos"        "velocity"     "distance"     #> [11] "time_in_INCR" "time_in_DECR" inspect(fish) #> [1] "No errors were found in the dataset"

title: Getting started with ShuttleboxR
text: trial_start omitted, first observation treated start trial whole recording labelled "trial". know clock time experimental trial began, provide import: Rows time labelled "acclimation". can exclude consistently calculations plots:
code: fish <- read_shuttlesoft(   file.choose(),   trial_start = "13:30:00" ) calc_Tpref(fish, exclude_acclimation = TRUE) calc_Tbreadth(fish, exclude_acclimation = TRUE) plot_coreT_histogram(fish, exclude_acclimation = TRUE)

title: Getting started with ShuttleboxR
text: default estimate preferred temperature median core_T: mean unbinned mode also available:
code: Tpref <- calc_Tpref(   fish,   method = "median",   print_results = FALSE ) Tpref #> [1] 13.72 calc_Tpref(fish, method = "mean", print_results = FALSE) #> [1] 14.71588 calc_Tpref(fish, method = "mode", print_results = FALSE) #> [1] 13.37

title: Getting started with ShuttleboxR
text: calc_Tavoid() returns lower upper percentiles observed core_T distribution. defaults 5th 95th percentiles: simple central range therefore:
code: Tavoid <- calc_Tavoid(   fish,   percentiles = c(0.05, 0.95),   print_results = FALSE ) Tavoid #> [1] 12.56 18.30 Tavoid[2] - Tavoid[1] #> [1] 5.74

title: Getting started with ShuttleboxR
text: calc_Tbreadth() uses complete frequency distribution rather upper lower limits. Temperatures divided fixed-width bins breadth calculated : BT=w∑ipi2, B_T = \frac{w}{\sum_i p_i^2}, ww bin width pip_i proportion observations bin ii. value expressed degrees Celsius. becomes larger animal uses broader range temperatures evenly. measure selected experienced temperature breadth, physiological thermal tolerance. Always use bin_size comparing animals.
code: Tbreadth <- calc_Tbreadth(   fish,   bin_size = 0.1,   print_results = FALSE ) Tbreadth #> [1] 1.664842

title: Getting started with ShuttleboxR
text: plot_coreT_histogram() displays percentage observations within temperature bin. dashed line marks midpoint frequently occupied bin, subtitle reports thermal breadth calculated bins.  plot returned invisibly, can also saved altered:
code: plot_coreT_histogram(fish, bin_size = 0.1) p <- plot_coreT_histogram(fish)  ggplot2::ggsave(   "core_temperature_histogram.png",   plot = p,   width = 7,   height = 5 )

title: Getting started with ShuttleboxR
text: Useful single-trial plots include:
code: shuttles <- calc_shuttles(fish, print_results = FALSE) occupancy <- calc_occupancy(fish, print_results = FALSE) distance <- calc_tot_distance(fish, print_results = FALSE) tracking <- calc_track_accuracy(fish, print_results = FALSE)  results <- data.frame(   metric = c(     "Preferred temperature (°C)",     "Lower avoidance temperature (°C)",     "Upper avoidance temperature (°C)",     "Effective thermal breadth (°C)",     "Number of shuttles",     "Seconds in DECR chamber",     "Seconds in INCR chamber",     "Total distance (cm)",     "Proportion tracked"   ),   value = c(     Tpref,     Tavoid[1],     Tavoid[2],     Tbreadth,     shuttles,     occupancy[1],     occupancy[2],     distance,     tracking   ) )  knitr::kable(results, digits = 3) plot_T_segmented(fish) plot_T_gradient(fish) plot_tracking(fish) plot_heatmap(fish) plot_distance(fish) plot_speed_coreT(fish)

title: Getting started with ShuttleboxR
text: PCA, first select variables scientifically relevant question. Including every numeric column automatically rarely desirable. Refit the PCA with a larger `ncp` before drawing #> a complete scree plot.  project_pca$plots$biplot project_pca$plots$screeplot project_pca$plots$pc1contributionplot project_pca$plots$varplot project_pca$pca_scores project_pca$pca_loadings project_pca$outliers

title: ShuttleboxR 0.0.0.9003
text: Added bundled 85-trial project-results database complete project-level analysis section vignette. Added read_project_database() import existing summary databases standardise column names used older ShuttleboxR versions. Updated project-level scatter plots correlation analysis work directly current legacy project-result column names return plot correlation objects. Repaired strengthened pca(), including input checks, missing-data handling, outlier reporting, reusable plot outputs.

title: ShuttleboxR 0.0.0.9002
text: Added complete getting-started vignette included example ShuttleSoft file. Added structured pkgdown reference index automated documentation website workflow. Expanded README added simple package-maintenance guide. read_shuttlesoft() read_shuttlesoft_project() now accept tab-delimited .txt files comma-separated .csv exports. plot_coreT_histogram() now reports effective selected thermal breadth, uses bin boundaries consistent calc_Tbreadth(), returns plot object invisibly.

title: ShuttleboxR 0.0.0.9001
text: Added calc_Tbreadth() effective selected thermal breadth based frequency distribution core_T. Made metadata optional importing single ShuttleSoft file. Added direct trial_start, mass, initial_T, a_value, b_value arguments read_shuttlesoft(). read_shuttlesoft() now prepares imported files default. Made file_prepare() robust trial start time supplied. Added direct thermal-model arguments calc_coreT() clarified a_value b_value require external calibration. Made metadata optional read_shuttlesoft_project(). Added Tbreadth calc_project_results() made recalculation core_T optional rather automatic.
